title: Assembly of the augmented Hom tower comparison
statement: Fix universes $d,t,u$, a prime $\ell$, a field $E$ finite-dimensional over $\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme $Y$ in universe $t$, a finite-field datum $D$ of characteristic $p$ in universe $d$, and $\ell\ne p$. On the small pro-etale site of $Y$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let $B=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$ and $B_n=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1})_Y$ be the coefficient sheaves [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(B)$ and $D(B_n)$ of module sheaves at coefficient universe $\max(u,t+1)$. Write $H_B,H_{B_n}$ for the recorded derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], $F_n:D(B)\to D(B_n)$ for derived reduction [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction], and $Q$ for complex localization. Fix $K\in D(B)$, a complex $G$, and a K-flat resolution $q:P\to G$. Let $H=H_B(K,-)$ and let $T(P)$ be the canonical quotient tower [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower], with augmentation $\gamma_q$ [lem-weil-integral-reduction-tower-well-defined]. There exist a complex $G\prime$, a K-flat resolution $q\prime:P\prime\to G\prime$, an isomorphism $e:QG\prime\simeq H(QG)$, and a natural isomorphism $\tau:T(P)\mathbin{\circ}H\simeq T(P\prime)$, where the left-hand side means applying $H$ to the tower, such that $e^{-1}\gamma_{q\prime,n}=H(\gamma_{q,n})\tau_n$ for every $n\ge0$. This statement imposes no completeness condition.

proof.text: Represent H(QG) by Q.objPreimage and its canonical isomorphism, and choose a K-flat resolution by the independent-coefficient resolution theorem.
